question: In a certain code language, ‘PHARMACEUTICAL’ is written as ‘QGBQNZDDVSJBBK’. How will ‘ELECTRONIC’ be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/259d8630a9ac11653540776fb8c878efe7c7e39d2fafd27847036c083bb6c14d.png] 

**Logic : (1) is added to and subtracted from each position value alternately starting with the addition.**

So,

 
• PHARMACEUTICAL is written as :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b956ca7af0dfcb5e048ba3ddd11800a99289f264c11ab288a399516635c9391a.png] ​

​Similarly,

 
• ELECTRONIC is written as :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5db7f7f4e36e90a1c6925c71e6fdfe5992c46062174076578dfc43804adc24d4.png] ​

Hence, **"****FKFBUQPMJB"** is the correct answer.
